name: claude-codex-buttons
display_name: Prompt Buttons: Prompt Bank and Notes
description: Your Prompt Bank, prompt variables and Notes in the Claude Desktop chat, synced automatically with Claude Code, Codex and your other computers through Google Drive.
long_description: Every saved prompt appears as a prompt you can insert from the chat, with {{?ask}} fields as arguments. Ask Claude to save a prompt, find one, or add to a note. Data is stored in ~/.claude-codex-buttons on this computer and, once you connect Google Drive, in your own Drive (drive.file permission only). See the privacy policy.
